# Regenerate:  LLVMDSDL_UPDATE_NAMING_GOLDEN=1 <build>/test/unit/llvmdsdl-unit-tests
#
# A diff in this file changes identifiers in generated code and is therefore an ABI
# change: it belongs in a commit that says so.
#
# reachable  whether the source name can appear in a conformant DSDL definition (charset
#            plus DSDL v1.0 section 3.2.5). Rows marked 'no' pin defensive behavior that
#            the compiler never reaches, but the language server and library callers do.
# file_stem  and type_name come from DefinitionPathProjection and are shown for version
#            1.0. They read '-' for a backend that derives that name elsewhere: C and C++
#            name headers after the raw DSDL short name, and C, C++ and Rust build
#            namespace-qualified type symbols.

== collisions ==
#
# Distinct DSDL-reachable sources that project onto one identifier. Unreachable sources
# are excluded: a clash they cause is not a hazard the compiler can meet.
#
# guard: what stops the collision from reaching generated code.
#   allocator  an in-scope name; the scope appends _2 (see naming-roles.txt).
#   rejected   an output file name or type name; the frontend rejects the pair, because
#              choosing which type to rename would depend on discovery order.

language projection   guard      identifier          sources
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
c        snake        allocator  a                   a, A

c        snake        allocator  efoo                Efoo, EFOO
c        snake        allocator  foo                 _foo, __foo, _Foo
c        snake        allocator  foo_                foo_, Foo_
c        snake        allocator  foo_bar             fooBar, foo_bar, FooBar, FOO_BAR
